# Localizer

Localizer helps you check translations for an iOS app and sync them back to Xcode. It is free and open source under the MIT License.

## Current behavior

- The dashboard and CLI work together on the user's computer without an account.
- The CLI reads the iOS project files. The dashboard does not browse the user's files.
- The dashboard receives app text and sends saved translations back to the CLI.
- `sync` writes `Localizer/Generated/Localizer.xcstrings` inside the iOS project.
- The built-in scan finds common SwiftUI text. A manifest file can cover text it misses.

## Important boundaries

- Localizer does not yet import GitHub projects, translate text automatically, open pull requests, or sync through the hosted website.
- The dashboard is desktop-only. Public marketing and policy routes are responsive.
- Do not treat prototype dashboard screens as production capabilities.
